user_query: I'm planning a trip to Europe next month and I need to exchange 1000 US Dollars to Euros. Can you provide me with the current exchange rate and the conversion amount? Additionally, suggest some popular tourist attractions in Paris and their opening hours.

TaskList.description: Fetch the current exchange rate from US Dollars to Euros.
Calculate the converted amount from 1000 US Dollars to Euros using the fetched exchange rate.
Retrieve information on popular tourist attractions in Paris.
Fetch the opening hours for the suggested tourist attractions in Paris.
